title: Staged eval orchestrator for model pin upgrades with tenant-priority and cost throttle
creator: Marissa Chen
description: Goal: implement a staged, policy-driven eval orchestrator that automatically runs targeted quality checks when a model version is pinned or a catalog/customer pin is upgraded. The orchestrator must prioritize tenants with recent traffic spikes, limit total token spend via a configurable cost throttle, and provide automated rollback hooks if regressions are detected. Flow: (1) Trigger: model_pin.upgrade event (catalog or tenant). (2) Stage A - fast smoke: 50 synthetic synthetic prompts sampled from pinned tenant's smoke set; pass/fail threshold configurable. (3) Stage B - tenant-prioritized sampled evals: run heavier metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/LLR/QA F1/custom QA predicates) for top-N tenants by 7d traffic; sample size variable per tenant. (4) Stage C - soft-fidelity sweep: lightweight cross-tenant checks across representative datasets for catalog-level visibility. (5) Decision: pass => promote pin; degraded => automatic rollback or canary restrict to reduced traffic. Key constraints: token spend cap per pin event, parallelism cap per region, and priority weighting for paid customers. Acceptance criteria: clear API for triggers and overrides; per-pin evaluation report in Console (metrics + diffs + cost); automatic rollback policy support; audit log entry and webhook/event emitted for every stage result; configurable risk thresholds per tenant and global defaults; unit and integration tests covering throttles and priority selection. Operational metrics: eval latency, tokens consumed, false-positive rollback rate, time-to-detect regression, % pins requiring manual intervention. Implementation notes: reuse existing eval harness and runner (ENG-30217) but add orchestrator component that manages staged pipelines, priority queue, and cost accounting. Backwards compatibility: default to current preflight behavior when feature flag off. Migration: opt-in flag for early customers, then gradual enable for catalog pins. Out-of-scope for this ticket: full UI for editing tenant thresholds (follow-up PM ticket), multi-model ensemble comparisons (research scope).
